title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 600  An Act Converting the Buayan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Kabasalan, Province of Zamboanga Into a National High School to Be Known as the Buayan National High School and Appropriating Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Buayan Barangay tại Thị trấn Kabasalan, Tỉnh Zamboanga thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Buayan Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Buayan Barangay ในเทศบาล Kabasalan จังหวัด Zamboanga เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Buayan แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Buayan Barangay di Kotamadya Kabasalan, Provinsi Zamboanga menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Buayan Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Buayan Barangay di Perbandaran Kabasalan, Wilayah Zamboanga kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Buayan Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Buayan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Kabasalan, Province of Zamboanga
del Sur, is converted into a national high school to be known as the Buayan National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
